hook: Millions of decoy mosquitoes bred to aid malaria control
what_happened: South Africa’s NICD and Wits University bred decoy mosquitoes using the Sterile Insect Technique
why_it_matters: It offers a new tool to reduce malaria transmission by overwhelming wild mosquito populations
the_catch: The approach is still in early stages and its field effectiveness has not yet been fully tested
caption: Scientists have bred millions of decoy mosquitoes to help fight malaria. Could this new strategy become a key part of malaria elimination efforts?
alt_text: A five-slide carousel explaining how South Africa’s NICD and Wits University are breeding decoy mosquitoes to aid malaria control using the Sterile Insect Technique

es.hook: Millones de mosquitos señuelo criados para ayudar al control de la malaria
es.what_happened: El NICD de Sudáfrica y la Universidad de Wits criaron mosquitos señuelo usando la Técnica de Insectos Esterilizados
es.why_it_matters: Ofrece una nueva herramienta para reducir la transmisión de malaria al sobrepasar las poblaciones de mosquitos salvajes
es.the_catch: El enfoque aún está en etapas iniciales y su efectividad en campo no ha sido completamente probada
